021import io.micronaut.core.util.StringUtils;

023import io.micronaut.maven.jib.JibConfigurationService;

033
034import javax.inject.Inject;
035import java.io.File;
036import java.io.IOException;
037import java.nio.file.Files;

045/**
046 * <p>Implementation of the <code>docker-native</code> packaging.</p>
047 * <p><strong>WARNING</strong>: this goal is not intended to be executed directly. Instead, specify the packaging type
048 * using the <code>packaging</code> property, eg:</p>
049 *
050 * <pre>mvn package -Dpackaging=docker-native</pre>
051 *
052 * @author Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal
053 * @author Iván López
054 * @since 1.1
055 */
056@Mojo(name = DockerNativeMojo.DOCKER_NATIVE_PACKAGING, requiresDependencyResolution = ResolutionScope.COMPILE_PLUS_RUNTIME)
057public class DockerNativeMojo extends AbstractDockerMojo {
058
059    public static final String DOCKER_NATIVE_PACKAGING = "docker-native";
060    public static final String MICRONAUT_PARENT = "io.micronaut.platform:micronaut-parent";
061    public static final String MICRONAUT_VERSION = "micronaut.version";
062    public static final String ARGS_FILE_PROPERTY_NAME = "graalvm.native-image.args-file";
063    static final int AWS_LAMBDA_MAX_ALLOWED_VERSION = 25;
064    static final int ORACLE_FUNCTION_MAX_ALLOWED_VERSION = 25;
065    static final int MAX_ALLOWED_VERSION = 25;
066    private MicronautRuntime runtime;
067
068    @SuppressWarnings("CdiInjectionPointsInspection")
069    @Inject
070    public DockerNativeMojo(MavenProject mavenProject, JibConfigurationService jibConfigurationService,
071                            ApplicationConfigurationService applicationConfigurationService, DockerService dockerService,
072                            MavenSession mavenSession, MojoExecution mojoExecution) {
073        super(mavenProject, jibConfigurationService, applicationConfigurationService, dockerService, mavenSession, mojoExecution);
074    }
075
076    @Override
077    public void execute() throws MojoExecutionException {
078        checkGraalVm();
079
080        try {
081            copyDependencies();
082
083            this.runtime = MicronautRuntime.valueOf(micronautRuntime.toUpperCase());
084
085            switch (runtime.getBuildStrategy()) {
086                case LAMBDA -> {
087                    checkJavaVersion(AWS_LAMBDA_MAX_ALLOWED_VERSION);
088                    buildDockerNativeLambda();
089                }
090                case ORACLE_FUNCTION -> {
091                    checkJavaVersion(ORACLE_FUNCTION_MAX_ALLOWED_VERSION);
092                    buildOracleCloud();
093                }
094                case DEFAULT -> {
095                    checkJavaVersion(MAX_ALLOWED_VERSION);
096                    buildDockerNative();
097                }
098                default -> throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected value: " + runtime.getBuildStrategy());
099            }
100
101
102        } catch (InvalidImageReferenceException iire) {
103            String message = "Invalid image reference "
104                + iire.getInvalidReference()
105                + ", perhaps you should check that the reference is formatted correctly according to " +
106                "https://docs.docker.com/engine/reference/commandline/tag/#extended-description" +
107                "\nFor example, slash-separated name components cannot have uppercase letters";
108            throw new MojoExecutionException(message);
109        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
110            throw new MojoExecutionException(e.getMessage(), e);
111        }
112    }
113
114    private void checkGraalVm() throws MojoExecutionException {
115        String micronautVersion = mavenProject.getProperties().getProperty(MICRONAUT_VERSION);
116        if (mavenProject.hasParent()) {
117            String ga = mavenProject.getParent().getGroupId() + ":" + mavenProject.getParent().getArtifactId();
118            if (MICRONAUT_PARENT.equals(ga)) {
119                String micronautParentVersion = mavenProject.getModel().getParent().getVersion();
120                if (micronautVersion.equals(micronautParentVersion)) {
121                    if (!mavenProject.getInjectedProfileIds().get(MICRONAUT_PARENT + ":" + micronautParentVersion).contains("graalvm")) {
122                        String javaVendor = System.getProperty("java.vendor", "");
123                        if (javaVendor.toLowerCase().contains("graalvm")) {
124                            throw new MojoExecutionException("The [graalvm] profile was not activated automatically because the native-image component is not installed (or not found in your path). Either activate the profile manually (-Pgraalvm) or install the native-image component (gu install native-image), and try again");
125                        } else {
126                            throw new MojoExecutionException("The [graalvm] profile was not activated automatically because you are not using a GraalVM JDK. Activate the profile manually (-Pgraalvm) and try again");
127                        }
128                    }
129                } else {
130                    String message = String.format("The %s version (%s) differs from the %s property (%s). Please, make sure both refer to the same version", MICRONAUT_PARENT, micronautParentVersion, MICRONAUT_VERSION, micronautVersion);
131                    throw new MojoExecutionException(message);
132                }
133            } else {
134                getLog().warn("The parent POM of this project is not set to " + MICRONAUT_PARENT);
135            }
136        } else {
137            getLog().warn("This project has no parent POM defined. To avoid build problems, please set the parent to " + MICRONAUT_PARENT);
138        }
139    }
140
141    private void checkJavaVersion(int maxAllowedVersion) throws MojoExecutionException {
142        if (javaVersion().getMajorVersion() > maxAllowedVersion) {
143            throw new MojoExecutionException("To build native images you must set the Java target byte code level to Java %s or below".formatted(maxAllowedVersion));
144        }
145    }
146
147    private void buildDockerNativeLambda() throws IOException {
148        var buildImageCmdArguments = new HashMap<String, String>();
149
150        // Add proxy settings if configured
151        buildImageCmdArguments.putAll(getProxyBuildArgs());
152
153        File dockerfile = dockerService.loadDockerfileAsResource(DockerfileMojo.DOCKERFILE_AWS_CUSTOM_RUNTIME);
154        lambdaBootstrapCommand(dockerfile);
155
156        // Starter sets the right class in pom.xml:
157        //   - For applications: io.micronaut.function.aws.runtime.MicronautLambdaRuntime
158        //   - For function apps: com.example.BookLambdaRuntime
159        BuildImageCmd buildImageCmd = addNativeImageBuildArgs(buildImageCmdArguments, () -> dockerService.buildImageCmd()
160            .withDockerfile(dockerfile)
161            .withBuildArg("GRAALVM_DOWNLOAD_URL", graalVmDownloadUrl()));
162        buildImageCmd.withBuildArg("CLASS_NAME", mainClass);
163        String imageId = dockerService.buildImage(buildImageCmd);
164        File functionZip = dockerService.copyFromContainer(imageId, "/function/function.zip");
165        getLog().info("AWS Lambda Custom Runtime ZIP: " + functionZip.getPath());
166    }
167
168    private void buildDockerNative() throws IOException, InvalidImageReferenceException {
169        String dockerfileName = DockerfileMojo.DOCKERFILE_NATIVE;
170        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(staticNativeImage)) {
171            getLog().info("Generating a static native image");
172            dockerfileName = DockerfileMojo.DOCKERFILE_NATIVE_STATIC;
173        } else if (baseImageRun.contains("distroless")) {
174            getLog().info("Generating a mostly static native image");
175            dockerfileName = DockerfileMojo.DOCKERFILE_NATIVE_DISTROLESS;
176        }
177
178        buildDockerfile(dockerfileName, true);
179    }
180
181    private void buildOracleCloud() throws IOException, InvalidImageReferenceException {
182        buildDockerfile(DockerfileMojo.DOCKERFILE_NATIVE_ORACLE_CLOUD, false);
183    }
184
185    private void buildDockerfile(String dockerfileName, boolean passClassName) throws IOException, InvalidImageReferenceException {
186        Set<String> tags = getTags();
187        for (String tag : tags) {
188            ImageReference.parse(tag);
189        }
190
191        String from = getFrom();
192        String ports = getPorts();
193        getLog().info("Exposing port(s): " + ports);
194
195        File dockerfile = dockerService.loadDockerfileAsResource(dockerfileName);
196
197        oracleCloudFunctionCmd(dockerfile);
198
199        var buildImageCmdArguments = new HashMap<String, String>();
200
201        // Add proxy settings if configured
202        buildImageCmdArguments.putAll(getProxyBuildArgs());
203
204        if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(baseImageRun) && Boolean.FALSE.equals(staticNativeImage)) {
205            buildImageCmdArguments.put("BASE_IMAGE_RUN", baseImageRun);
206        }
207
208        if (passClassName) {
209            buildImageCmdArguments.put("CLASS_NAME", mainClass);
210        }
211
212        BuildImageCmd buildImageCmd = addNativeImageBuildArgs(buildImageCmdArguments, () -> dockerService.buildImageCmd()
213            .withDockerfile(dockerfile)
214            .withTags(getTags())
215            .withBuildArg("BASE_IMAGE", from)
216            .withBuildArg("PORTS", ports));
217
218        dockerService.buildImage(buildImageCmd);
219    }
220
221    private BuildImageCmd addNativeImageBuildArgs(Map<String, String> buildImageCmdArguments, Supplier<BuildImageCmd> buildImageCmdSupplier) throws IOException {
222        String argsFile = mavenProject.getProperties().getProperty(ARGS_FILE_PROPERTY_NAME);
223        List<String> allNativeImageBuildArgs = MojoUtils.computeNativeImageArgs(nativeImageBuildArgs, baseImageRun, argsFile);
224        //Remove extra main class argument
225        allNativeImageBuildArgs.remove(mainClass);
226        getLog().info("GraalVM native image build args: " + allNativeImageBuildArgs);
227        List<String> conversionResult = NativeImageUtils.convertToArgsFile(allNativeImageBuildArgs, Paths.get(mavenProject.getBuild().getDirectory()));
228        if (conversionResult.size() == 1) {
229            Files.delete(Paths.get(argsFile));
230
231            BuildImageCmd buildImageCmd = buildImageCmdSupplier.get();
232
233            for (Map.Entry<String, String> buildArg : buildImageCmdArguments.entrySet()) {
234                buildImageCmd.withBuildArg(buildArg.getKey(), buildArg.getValue());
235            }
236
237            getNetworkMode().ifPresent(buildImageCmd::withNetworkMode);
238            return buildImageCmd;
239        } else {
240            throw new IOException("Unable to convert native image build args to args file");
241        }
242    }
243
244}
